label: Advanced
blurb: The register of memos, meetings and school news — plus the high-frequency 成語 (idioms) that actually turn up in a principal's speech or a newsletter. Every idiom here is one you will genuinely meet on campus.
blurbZh: 公文、會議與校園新聞的語域，再加上校長致詞與校刊裡真的會出現的高頻成語。這裡收的每一個成語，都是你在校園裡遇得到的。
idiomRatio: 10 of 30 questions in this pilot are 成語 items.

questions.q: The office says your workshop expenses still need 核銷. You must —
opts: submit receipts so the expense can be settled and reimbursed
questions.why: 核銷 (héxiāo) is the accounting step where receipts are checked and the expense is written off against the budget. No 核銷, no reimbursement — always keep the 收據 (shōujù).

questions.q: Your director asks you to help prepare a 簽呈. This is —
opts: an internal memo routed for approval
questions.why: 簽呈 (qiānchéng) is the internal request memo that travels up the chain for signatures. 公文 (gōngwén) is the broader term for official documents.

questions.q: An email asks who the 承辦人 for the bilingual project is. They want to know —
opts: the staff member handling the case day to day
questions.why: 承辦人 (chéngbànrén) is the person actually responsible for a case or project. When you're asked 誰是承辦人？they want the name to contact, not the boss.

questions.q: A plan is titled 教師專業精進計畫. 精進 here means —
questions.why: 精進 (jīngjìn) = to refine and advance. 教師專業精進 is the standard label for teacher professional development programs.

questions.q: The 108 curriculum guidelines call for 素養導向教學. This means teaching that is —
opts: competency-oriented — knowledge applied in real situations
questions.why: 素養 (sùyǎng) = competency or literacy in the broad sense. 素養導向 shifts the goal from memorising content to using it in authentic contexts.

questions.q: You're invited to design a 跨領域 course with the science teacher. This course is —
questions.why: 跨領域 (kuà lǐngyù) = across subject domains. English + science or English + arts co-taught units are the most common form for FETs.

questions.q: Your name appears on the schedule for 教學觀摩 next month. You will —
opts: observe a colleague and write a report
be formally evaluated for your contract
teach a demonstration lesson that other teachers observe
questions.why: 教學觀摩 (jiàoxué guānmó) is the open demonstration lesson. It is professional sharing, not a performance review — the review term is 教學評鑑 (jiàoxué píngjiàn).

questions.q: You can claim 差旅費 for attending the county workshop. This covers —
questions.why: 差旅費 (chāilǚfèi) = travel expenses for official business. Keep tickets and receipts — they go into the 核銷 (héxiāo) paperwork.

questions.zh: 這份公文要在星期五之前回覆
questions.py: zhè fèn gōngwén yào zài xīngqíwǔ zhīqián huífù
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. You are being told that something must be replied to before Friday. What is it?
questions.why: 公文 (gōngwén) = official document. They arrive with a 期限 (qíxiàn, deadline), and missing it is taken seriously by the office.

questions.q: A document is submitted 報教育處備查. This means it is sent to the Education Bureau —
opts: to be filed for the record
for approval before it can proceed
questions.why: 備查 (bèichá) = filed for reference — no approval needed, it just has to be on record. Contrast 核定 (hédìng), which does require approval.

questions.zh: 我們學校的英語成績名列前茅
questions.py: wǒmen xuéxiào de yīngyǔ chéngjī míng liè qián máo
questions.q: The principal says 我們學校的英語成績名列前茅. This means the results are —
questions.why: 名列前茅 (míng liè qián máo) = to rank among the top. The 前茅 were the reed banners carried at the front of an ancient army — hence 'out in front'.

questions.q: A speaker praises a teacher for 因材施教. They are describing teaching that —
opts: adapts to each student's ability and character
questions.why: 因材施教 (yīn cái shī jiào) = teach according to the material you have — the student. It comes from Confucius and is the standard phrase for differentiated instruction.

questions.q: Which situation best fits 一石二鳥?
opts: A project that fails despite great effort
An English camp that also builds students' confidence
A lesson that has to be repeated twice
Two teachers disagreeing on a plan
questions.why: 一石二鳥 (yì shí èr niǎo) = one stone, two birds — exactly the English 'kill two birds with one stone'. 一舉兩得 (yì jǔ liǎng dé) means the same thing.

questions.py: xué yǔyán yào xún xù jiàn jìn
questions.q: 學語言要循序漸進 advises learners to —
opts: advance step by step in proper order
questions.why: 循序漸進 (xún xù jiàn jìn) = follow the sequence and progress gradually. You will hear it whenever curriculum design is discussed.

questions.q: Using the right teaching tool can make your work 事半功倍 — that is —
opts: half the effort, double the result
double the effort, half the result
twice as long but more thorough
questions.why: 事半功倍 (shì bàn gōng bèi) = half the work, twice the effect. Its opposite, 事倍功半 (shì bèi gōng bàn), flips the two characters and the meaning — watch the word order.

questions.q: Teachers must accumulate enough 研習時數 each year. These are —
questions.why: 研習時數 (yánxí shíshù) are the certified in-service training hours, logged on the 全國教師在職進修網 platform.

questions.q: Your bilingual club is counted as 校訂課程. This means it is —
opts: a temporary pilot with no credit
designed by the school itself within the national framework
mandated by the Ministry of Education
questions.why: 校訂課程 (xiàodìng kèchéng) is the school-designed portion of the curriculum, as opposed to 部訂課程 (bùdìng kèchéng), the ministry-mandated core.

questions.q: An official letter ends with 請惠予協助. This is —
opts: a warning that action is overdue
a formal 'your kind assistance would be appreciated'
a statement that the matter is closed
questions.why: 請惠予協助 (qǐng huì yǔ xié zhù) is set 公文 politeness — literally 'please graciously grant assistance'. Nobody says this out loud; it lives in writing.

questions.q: A project document lists the 期程. This section gives the —
questions.why: 期程 (qíchéng) = the time frame or schedule of a plan. Paired terms you'll see nearby: 期限 (qíxiàn, deadline) and 經費 (jīngfèi, funding).

questions.q: A school motto reads 有教無類. It expresses the belief that —
opts: education should be offered to everyone regardless of background
classes should be streamed by ability
only motivated students should be taught
questions.why: 有教無類 (yǒu jiào wú lèi) = 'in teaching, no categories' — Confucius on universal education. You'll see it carved on school walls across Taiwan.

questions.py: zhè liǎng ge bǎnběn dà tóng xiǎo yì
questions.q: A colleague says the two lesson plans are 大同小異. They are —
opts: mostly the same with minor differences
questions.why: 大同小異 (dà tóng xiǎo yì) = largely alike, slightly different. Useful when comparing textbook versions or draft documents.

questions.q: Your co-teaching plan must go to the 課發會. This is the —
questions.why: 課發會 (kèfāhuì) is short for 課程發展委員會 — the in-school committee that reviews and approves curriculum plans each year.

questions.q: The bureau is coming for 訪視 next week. The school is preparing for —
questions.why: 訪視 (fǎngshì) is the formal site visit by a supervising body. Expect tidy classrooms, prepared documents, and a possible request to teach a short demo.

questions.q: A retiring principal is praised as 腳踏實地. They were —
opts: down-to-earth and steady in their work
questions.why: 腳踏實地 (jiǎo tà shí dì) = feet planted on solid ground — practical, reliable, no shortcuts. High praise in a Taiwanese workplace.

questions.q: A workshop is titled 教師增能工作坊. 增能 means —
questions.why: 增能 (zēngnéng) = capacity building, literally 'increase ability'. It appears constantly in bilingual education program titles.

questions.q: A teacher who is 精益求精 —
opts: keeps improving even when already good
questions.why: 精益求精 (jīng yì qiú jīng) = already fine, yet seeking finer still. It's the phrase used in awards and commendations.

questions.q: A homeroom teacher mentions doing 家訪 this weekend. They will —
questions.why: 家訪 (jiāfǎng) = home visit. It is still common in rural Changhua schools, especially for students facing difficulties.

questions.q: Visitors say the renovated English classroom is 耳目一新. They found it —
questions.why: 耳目一新 (ěr mù yī xīn) = ears and eyes made new — a pleasantly fresh impression. Common in school news write-ups.

questions.q: The director suggests a 微調 to your syllabus. They want —
questions.why: 微調 (wēitiáo) = fine-tuning, a small adjustment. If they wanted a rebuild they'd say 重新規劃 (chóngxīn guīhuà).

questions.q: You're asked to join 雙語共備 every Wednesday. This is —
opts: collaborative lesson planning with the subject teacher
questions.why: 共備 (gòngbèi) is short for 共同備課 — teachers planning a lesson together. For FETs this is the core of co-teaching with a Taiwanese partner.

questions.q: A budget marked 已核定 has been —
questions.why: 核定 (hédìng) = formally approved. Contrast 備查 (bèichá), which is merely filed for the record.

questions.q: In official correspondence, 函 is —
questions.why: 函 (hán) is the standard official letter format between government bodies. 令 (lìng) is a directive from a higher authority.

questions.q: The 主旨 line of a 公文 gives the —
questions.why: 主旨 (zhǔzhǐ) is the one-line summary at the top of every Taiwanese official document. 說明 (shuōmíng) follows with the details.

questions.q: In a 公文, the 說明 section contains the —
opts: numbered details supporting the 主旨
questions.why: 說明 (shuōmíng) sets out the background and specifics, point by point, beneath the one-line 主旨.

questions.q: Listing a unit under 副本 means they —
questions.why: 副本 (fùběn) = cc'd copy. 正本 (zhèngběn) names the recipient who must actually act.

questions.q: A principal urges the team to 全力以赴. They should —
questions.why: 全力以赴 (quán lì yǐ fù) = go at it with full strength. Standard rallying language before a competition or inspection.

questions.q: After a win, a speaker says 再接再厲. They mean —
opts: keep up the effort and push further
questions.why: 再接再厲 (zài jiē zài lì) = press on with renewed effort. Said after a success, not a failure.

questions.q: The school's progress is described as 有目共睹 — it is —
questions.why: 有目共睹 (yǒu mù gòng dǔ) = anyone with eyes can see it. Common in commendations and news write-ups.

questions.q: A supporter who is 不遺餘力 —
questions.why: 不遺餘力 (bù yí yú lì) = holds nothing back. Often used to thank a sponsor or the 家長會.

questions.q: Two things described as 息息相關 are —
opts: closely bound up with each other
questions.why: 息息相關 (xī xī xiāng guān) = as linked as breath itself. Used for language and culture, health and learning, and so on.

questions.q: 研擬 a plan means to —
questions.why: 研擬 (yánnǐ) = to study and draft. You'll see 研擬中 (under development) on plans not yet finalised.

questions.q: 擬定 means to —
opts: draw up and settle a plan
questions.why: 擬定 (nǐdìng) = to formulate. 擬定計畫 is to draw up a plan; 執行 (zhíxíng) is to carry it out.

questions.q: 計畫執行 refers to the —
questions.why: 執行 (zhíxíng) = to implement. 執行率 (zhíxínglǜ) is how much of a budget or plan has actually been delivered.

questions.q: A 檢討會議 after an event is a —
opts: review meeting to learn from it
questions.why: 檢討 (jiǎntǎo) = to review critically. Neutral in a work context — it means 'let's look at what to improve', not blame.

questions.q: 🔊 Listen. The question is asking —
questions.why: 由誰 (yóu shéi) = by whom. 承辦 (chéngbàn) is to take charge of a case — the person is the 承辦人.

questions.q: 預算 is the —
questions.why: 預算 (yùsuàn) = budget. 決算 (juésuàn) is the final settlement once the year's spending is closed.

questions.q: 採購 refers to —
questions.why: 採購 (cǎigòu) = procurement. Public schools follow the 政府採購法, so even small purchases have set procedures.

questions.q: 驗收 happens when goods are —
opts: checked and formally accepted on delivery
questions.why: 驗收 (yànshōu) = acceptance inspection. No 驗收, no payment — the supplier can't be paid until it's signed off.

questions.q: 招標 is the process of —
questions.why: 招標 (zhāobiāo) = to invite bids. 得標 (débiāo) means winning the tender; 流標 means it failed to attract bids.

questions.q: 廠商 refers to the —
questions.why: 廠商 (chǎngshāng) = supplier or contractor. School events involving catering, printing or buses all deal with 廠商.

questions.q: 眾所皆知 introduces something that is —
questions.why: 眾所皆知 (zhòng suǒ jiē zhī) = as everyone knows. A speechmaker's way of opening on common ground.

questions.q: Learning through 潛移默化 happens —
questions.why: 潛移默化 (qián yí mò huà) = to be changed quietly over time. The standard phrase for how environment shapes a child.

questions.q: 寓教於樂 describes teaching that —
questions.why: 寓教於樂 (yù jiào yú lè) = to lodge teaching inside pleasure. Exactly what a good FET lesson is praised for.

questions.q: 教學相長 means that —
opts: teaching and learning grow together — the teacher learns too
questions.why: 教學相長 (jiào xué xiāng zhǎng) comes from the 禮記. A humble, generous thing to say about a co-teaching partnership.

questions.q: A meeting called to 集思廣益 aims to —
opts: gather everyone's ideas for a better result
questions.why: 集思廣益 (jí sī guǎng yì) = pool thinking, widen the benefit. The polite way to open a brainstorming session.

questions.q: In the Taiwanese curriculum, 領域 refers to a —
questions.why: 領域 (lǐngyù) = learning domain, e.g. 語文領域, 數學領域. 跨領域 means working across two or more.

questions.q: 課綱 refers to the —
questions.why: 課綱 (kègāng) = curriculum guidelines. Taiwan's current set is the 十二年國教課綱, known as the 108 課綱.

questions.q: 彈性課程 is curriculum time the school —
opts: designs flexibly for its own priorities
questions.why: 彈性學習課程 (tánxìng xuéxí kèchéng) is the flexible block where bilingual clubs and school-designed courses usually live.

questions.q: 議題融入 means major themes such as sustainability are —
questions.why: 議題融入 (yìtí róngrù) = issue integration. The 108 課綱 lists 19 issues — 性別平等, 環境, 國際教育 among them.

questions.q: 國際教育 in Taiwanese schools aims to —
opts: build students' global understanding and competence
questions.why: 國際教育 (guójì jiàoyù) is a named policy area — 國際教育 2.0. FET placements and sister schools sit under it.

questions.py: zhè shì běn xiào de tèsè kèchéng
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. The speaker is describing the school's —
questions.why: 本校 (běn xiào) = this school (formal). 特色課程 (tèsè kèchéng) is the distinctive course a school is known for.

questions.q: 本校 in a formal document means —
opts: the head school of a district
questions.why: 本 (běn) = this / our own, in formal register. 本縣 = this county, 本案 = this case, 本人 = myself.

questions.q: 貴校 is how you refer to —
opts: the school you are addressing, respectfully
questions.why: 貴 (guì) is the honorific 'your' — 貴校, 貴單位, 貴賓. Pairs with the humble 本 for your own side.

questions.q: 貴賓蒞臨 means the guests have —
questions.why: 蒞臨 (lìlín) is the honorific 'to arrive'. You'll hear 感謝各位貴賓蒞臨 at the start of every school ceremony.

questions.q: 貴賓 refers to —
questions.why: 貴賓 (guìbīn) = VIP guest. At a school event they get the front row and a 貴賓 badge.

questions.q: 校長致詞 is the principal —
questions.why: 致詞 (zhìcí) = to give a speech at a ceremony. As an FET you may be asked to 致詞 in English — keep it short.

questions.q: 頒獎 is the act of —
questions.why: 頒獎 (bānjiǎng) = to present a prize. 得獎 (déjiǎng) is to win one; 頒獎典禮 is the awards ceremony.

questions.q: 榮獲 in school news means to have —
questions.why: 榮獲 (rónghuò) = to receive with honour. School news is full of 本校榮獲… — 'our school proudly won…'.

questions.q: 表揚 means to —
questions.why: 表揚 (biǎoyáng) = public commendation, usually at 朝會. 表揚大會 is a formal commendation ceremony.

questions.zh: 感謝各位長官蒞臨指導
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. This is the opening of a —
questions.why: 長官 (zhǎngguān) = superiors/officials; 指導 (zhǐdǎo) = guidance. This exact sentence opens countless Taiwanese school ceremonies.

questions.q: A team that is 各司其職 —
opts: each does their own job properly
questions.why: 各司其職 (gè sī qí zhí) = each attends to their own duty. Praise for a well-organized event team.

questions.q: An event described as 井然有序 was —
questions.why: 井然有序 (jǐng rán yǒu xù) = neat and in order, like a well-laid field grid. Standard praise in an event report.

questions.q: Planning that is 面面俱到 —
opts: is done at the last minute
questions.why: 面面俱到 (miàn miàn jù dào) = every side attended to. High praise for thorough preparation.

questions.q: A teacher described as 循循善誘 —
opts: guides students patiently, step by step
lets students find their own way
questions.why: 循循善誘 (xún xún shàn yòu) comes from the 論語, describing Confucius's own teaching. Among the warmest compliments a teacher can receive.

questions.q: 春風化雨 praises a teacher for —
opts: nurturing students gently, like spring wind and rain
questions.why: 春風化雨 (chūn fēng huà yǔ) is the classic image of a teacher's quiet nurturing influence. Common on retirement plaques.

questions.q: 評鑑 is a —
questions.why: 評鑑 (píngjiàn) = formal evaluation, with criteria and a rating. Heavier than 訪視 (fǎngshì), a site visit.

questions.q: 自評 requires a school to —
questions.why: 自評 (zìpíng) = self-evaluation, submitted before the external 訪視 or 評鑑 team arrives.

questions.q: An entry that reaches 複審 has —
opts: passed the first round and gone to a second review
questions.why: 初審 (chūshěn) is the first review, 複審 (fùshěn) the second. School award competitions usually run both.

questions.q: 抽測 is a —
questions.why: 抽測 (chōucè) = spot-check testing on a sample, used by the bureau to monitor standards across schools.

questions.q: A 成果報告 is submitted —
opts: before a program, to request funding
during a program, as a progress note
after a program, to report outcomes
questions.why: 成果報告 (chéngguǒ bàogào) = outcome report, with photos, figures and reflections. Required to close out most funded projects.

questions.q: 雙語教學 in Taiwan means teaching —
opts: English as a separate subject only
questions.why: 雙語教學 (shuāngyǔ jiàoxué) delivers subjects like PE, art or health partly in English — not simply more English lessons.

questions.q: 沉浸式 teaching means students are —
questions.why: 沉浸式 (chénjìnshì) = immersive. 沉浸式教學 is the fuller-immersion end of the bilingual spectrum.

questions.q: 學科內容 refers to the —
questions.why: 學科內容 (xuékē nèiróng) = subject content. In CLIL the pairing is 學科內容 plus 語言 (language) — both are objectives.

questions.q: A 推動小組 is a —
opts: working group driving a policy forward
questions.why: 推動 (tuīdòng) = to push forward. 雙語教育推動小組 is the in-school team steering the bilingual program.

questions.q: 教材研發 means to —
questions.why: 研發 (yánfā) = research and development. 教材 (jiàocái) is teaching material — the textbooks, worksheets and slides.

questions.q: 教材 refers to —
questions.why: 教材 (jiàocái) = teaching materials. 自編教材 (zìbiān jiàocái) is material a teacher writes themselves.

questions.q: In the 課綱, 學習表現 describes —
opts: what students should be able to do
questions.why: 學習表現 (xuéxí biǎoxiàn) is the performance dimension — the verbs. Its partner 學習內容 (xuéxí nèiróng) is the content.

questions.q: 素養 in Taiwanese education policy means —
opts: competence: knowledge, skills and attitudes combined
questions.why: 素養 (sùyǎng) is the organizing idea of the 108 課綱 — what a person can actually do with what they know.

questions.zh: 這學期我們推動雙語教學
questions.py: zhè xuéqí wǒmen tuīdòng shuāngyǔ jiàoxué
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. This semester the school is —
questions.why: 學期 (xuéqí) = semester. 推動 (tuīdòng) = to promote or drive forward a policy.

questions.py: shí nián shù mù, bǎi nián shù rén
questions.q: 十年樹木，百年樹人 means that —
opts: educating people is the work of generations
trees take a century to grow
schools should plan a hundred years ahead
questions.why: 百年樹人 (bǎi nián shù rén) — 'a hundred years to cultivate a person'. The most quoted line at Taiwanese school anniversaries.

questions.q: A retiring teacher praised as 桃李滿天下 has —
questions.why: 桃李 (peaches and plums) is a classical metaphor for students. 桃李滿天下 = your students are everywhere.

questions.q: 學以致用 means to —
opts: put what you learn to practical use
learn for the sake of learning
questions.why: 學以致用 (xué yǐ zhì yòng) is the traditional phrasing of what 素養導向 aims at — knowledge that gets used.

questions.q: 溫故知新 advises learners to —
opts: review the old to discover the new
questions.why: 溫故知新 (wēn gù zhī xīn) is from the 論語. A neat justification for spending class time on revision.

questions.q: A student who can 舉一反三 —
opts: extends one example to related cases
questions.why: 舉一反三 (jǔ yī fǎn sān) — shown one corner, they infer the other three. Confucius's own test of a good learner.

questions.q: 融會貫通 describes understanding that is —
questions.why: 融會貫通 (róng huì guàn tōng) = melted together and threaded through. The goal of 跨領域 teaching, stated classically.

questions.q: In Changhua County, the 教育處 is the —
questions.why: 教育處 (jiàoyùchù) is the county-level education department. At national level it is the 教育部 (jiàoyùbù), the Ministry.

questions.q: 教育部 is the —
questions.why: 教育部 (jiàoyùbù) = Ministry of Education. 部 marks a national ministry; 處 a county-level department.

questions.q: An 輔導團 in the county system is a —
opts: team of expert teachers supporting other schools
questions.why: 輔導團 (fǔdǎotuán) = curriculum advisory team. Experienced teachers seconded to mentor colleagues county-wide.

questions.q: A 專業學習社群 is a —
questions.why: 專業學習社群 (zhuānyè xuéxí shèqún), or PLC, is a teacher group meeting regularly to improve practice together.

questions.zh: 請問這份公文的期限是什麼時候？
questions.py: qǐngwèn zhè fèn gōngwén de qíxiàn shì shénme shíhòu?
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. The speaker is asking about the document's —
questions.why: 期限 (qíxiàn) = deadline. 什麼時候 (shénme shíhòu) = when. Missing a 公文 deadline is taken seriously.

questions.q: 逾期 means —
questions.why: 逾期 (yúqí) = overdue. 逾期未辦 (overdue and unhandled) is the phrase nobody wants next to their name.

questions.q: 陳報 means to —
opts: report formally upward to a higher authority
questions.why: 陳報 (chénbào) is the formal upward report. The 公文 verb set: 陳報 up, 轉知 across, 通知 down.

questions.q: 轉知 means to —
opts: pass the information on to those concerned
questions.why: 轉知 (zhuǎnzhī) = to relay. 請轉知相關人員 — 'please pass this on to the relevant staff' — closes many 公文.

questions.q: 依規定辦理 means to handle the matter —
questions.why: 依規定 (yī guīdìng) = per the rules. 辦理 (bànlǐ) = to process or handle — one of the busiest verbs in 公文.

questions.q: 辦理 means to —
questions.why: 辦理 (bànlǐ) covers processing anything official — 辦理報名, 辦理核銷, 辦理研習.

questions.q: Someone working 廢寢忘食 is —
opts: so absorbed they forget to sleep and eat
questions.why: 廢寢忘食 (fèi qǐn wàng shí) = to neglect sleep and meals. Admiring, though these days often said with a note of concern.

questions.q: 持之以恆 means to —
opts: keep at it consistently over time
questions.why: 持之以恆 (chí zhī yǐ héng) = to persevere. The advice given to any student learning a language.

questions.q: A learner who is 孜孜不倦 is —
questions.why: 孜孜不倦 (zī zī bú juàn) = tirelessly diligent. Often paired with 好學 (hàoxué), fond of learning.

questions.q: A student who is 出類拔萃 —
opts: stands out well above their peers
questions.why: 出類拔萃 (chū lèi bá cuì) = to rise clear of the crowd. Stronger than 名列前茅, which is about ranking.

questions.q: Two things that are 相輔相成 —
questions.why: 相輔相成 (xiāng fǔ xiāng chéng) = mutually reinforcing. Perfect for describing content and language in bilingual teaching.

questions.q: 總結 means to —
questions.why: 總結 (zǒngjié) = to summarise or wrap up. 總結性評量 (zǒngjiéxìng píngliàng) is summative assessment.

questions.q: 形成性評量 takes place —
opts: at the end of a course
questions.why: 形成性評量 = formative assessment, during learning. 總結性評量 = summative, at the end.

questions.q: 多元評量 means assessment that —
opts: uses varied methods, not just written tests
questions.why: 多元評量 (duōyuán píngliàng) = multiple forms of assessment — performance, portfolio, oral, project. Central to 素養導向.

questions.q: 檔案評量 assesses students through —
questions.why: 檔案評量 (dǎng'àn píngliàng) = portfolio assessment. 學習歷程檔案 is the senior-high version that follows students to university.

questions.zh: 我們採用多元評量的方式
questions.py: wǒmen cǎiyòng duōyuán píngliàng de fāngshì
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. The school uses —
questions.why: 採用 (cǎiyòng) = to adopt or use; 方式 (fāngshì) = method or approach.

questions.q: 差異化教學 adapts teaching to —
questions.why: 差異化教學 (chāyìhuà jiàoxué) = differentiated instruction — the modern policy phrasing of 因材施教.

questions.q: 翻轉教室 means students —
opts: study content before class and practice in class
questions.why: 翻轉教室 (fānzhuǎn jiàoshì) = flipped classroom. Widely discussed in Taiwan since the 2010s.

questions.q: 專題研究 refers to —
opts: an in-depth project on a specific topic
questions.why: 專題 (zhuāntí) = special topic. 專題報告 is a project report; 專題演講 a keynote talk.

questions.q: 演講 is a —
questions.why: 演講 (yǎnjiǎng) = speech. 英語演講比賽 (English speech contest) is a fixture FETs are asked to coach and judge.

questions.q: 比賽 means a —
questions.why: 比賽 (bǐsài) = contest. 朗讀比賽 (reading aloud), 演講比賽 (speech), 說故事比賽 (storytelling) — all common in Changhua.

questions.q: 朗讀比賽 tests students' ability to —
questions.why: 朗讀 (lǎngdú) = to read aloud from a text. Distinct from 演講, where students speak from memory.

questions.q: You are invited to be a 評審. You will —
questions.why: 評審 (píngshěn) = judge or adjudicator. FETs are regularly asked to 擔任評審 at English contests.

questions.q: 擔任 means to —
questions.why: 擔任 (dānrèn) = to take on a position. 擔任評審, 擔任導師, 擔任主持人 (to host).

questions.q: 主持 an event means to —
questions.why: 主持 (zhǔchí) = to preside over. 主持人 (zhǔchírén) is the MC or chairperson.

questions.zh: 請您擔任這次比賽的評審
questions.py: qǐng nín dānrèn zhè cì bǐsài de píngshěn
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. You are being invited to —
questions.why: 您 (nín) is the respectful 'you'. 這次 (zhè cì) = this time / this occasion.

questions.q: 錦上添花 describes adding something —
opts: good to what is already good
questions.why: 錦上添花 = flowers on brocade. Its counterpart 雪中送炭 (charcoal in the snow) is help given when truly needed.

questions.q: 雪中送炭 means to give help —
opts: exactly when it is most needed
questions.why: 雪中送炭 (xuě zhōng sòng tàn) — bringing charcoal in the snow. The highest praise for a timely donation or act of support.

questions.q: 水到渠成 suggests that with the right conditions, results —
questions.why: 水到渠成 (shuǐ dào qú chéng) — when the water arrives, the channel forms. Do the groundwork and the outcome follows.

questions.q: A problem that is 迎刃而解 —
opts: resolves itself readily once the key issue is dealt with
questions.why: 迎刃而解 (yíng rèn ér jiě) — like bamboo splitting cleanly at the blade. Everything else falls into place.

questions.q: Someone doing a task 得心應手 is —
opts: learning it for the first time
questions.why: 得心應手 (dé xīn yìng shǒu) — mind and hand in agreement. Fluent, practiced, effortless.

questions.q: 偏鄉學校 are schools in —
questions.why: 偏鄉 (piānxiāng) = remote rural area. Much of Changhua's FET placement work targets 偏鄉 schools with fewer resources.

questions.q: 弱勢學生 refers to students who are —
questions.why: 弱勢 (ruòshì) = disadvantaged. 弱勢家庭 (disadvantaged families) qualify for fee waivers and 補救教學.

questions.q: 新住民 refers to —
opts: immigrant residents, often spouses from Southeast Asia
questions.why: 新住民 (xīnzhùmín) = new residents. Their children are 新二代, and many Changhua schools teach 新住民語文.

questions.q: 原住民 refers to Taiwan's —
questions.why: 原住民 (yuánzhùmín) = indigenous peoples — 16 officially recognized nations. 族語 (zúyǔ) is indigenous-language teaching.

questions.q: 補助 refers to —
questions.why: 補助 (bǔzhù) = subsidy. 申請補助 (shēnqǐng bǔzhù) is to apply for a grant — the start of most school projects.

questions.q: 申請 means to —
questions.why: 申請 (shēnqǐng) = to apply. 申請表 is the application form; 核准 (hézhǔn) is approval.

questions.q: 核准 means —
questions.why: 核准 (hézhǔn) = approved. Near-synonym of 核定; 駁回 (bóhuí) means rejected and sent back.

questions.q: 🔊 Listen. The plan has —
questions.why: 已經…了 (yǐjīng … le) marks something as already done. 核准了 = approval has come through.

questions.q: 實施 means to —
questions.why: 實施 (shíshī) = to implement a policy or plan. 實施計畫 (shíshī jìhuà) is the implementation plan document.

questions.q: In an official title such as 補助辦法, 辦法 means —
opts: a set of regulations governing how something is done
questions.why: 辦法 (bànfǎ) = regulations or measures. In everyday speech it also just means 'a way' — 沒辦法 = there's no way.

questions.q: A colleague shrugs and says 沒辦法. They mean —
opts: nothing can be done about it
questions.why: 沒辦法 (méi bànfǎ) = there's no way around it. Resigned rather than rude — a very common Taiwanese response to red tape.

questions.q: An official 要點 document sets out —
opts: the key points and rules for a scheme
questions.why: 要點 (yàodiǎn) = essential points, used in titles like 補助要點. Lighter in legal weight than 辦法.

questions.q: A 研習手冊 is the —
questions.why: 手冊 (shǒucè) = handbook or manual. Every Taiwanese 研習 comes with one, often thick and color-printed.

questions.q: Something 名副其實 —
questions.why: 名副其實 (míng fù qí shí) = the name matches the reality. Its opposite is 名不副實.

questions.q: 一鳴驚人 describes someone who —
opts: astonishes everyone with a sudden breakthrough
questions.why: 一鳴驚人 (yì míng jīng rén) — the bird silent for years that startles all when it finally calls. For an unheralded winner.

questions.q: Students who 大開眼界 on a trip have —
questions.why: 大開眼界 (dà kāi yǎn jiè) = to have one's eyes opened wide. The line every 國際交流 report ends on.

questions.q: A lesson design that is 別出心裁 is —
questions.why: 別出心裁 (bié chū xīn cái) = cut from a different pattern. Praise for creative teaching or an inventive display.

questions.q: Work described as 有條不紊 is —
questions.why: 有條不紊 (yǒu tiáo bù wěn) = orderly, with no threads out of place. Close to 井然有序, but about process rather than scene.

questions.q: Someone 一絲不苟 is —
opts: meticulous down to the last detail
questions.why: 一絲不苟 (yì sī bù gǒu) = not one thread careless. High praise for the colleague who checks every figure.

questions.q: 日新月異 describes change that is —
questions.why: 日新月異 (rì xīn yuè yì) = new by the day, different by the month. The standard opener for a speech about technology.

questions.q: 數位學習 refers to —
questions.why: 數位 (shùwèi) = digital. Taiwan's 數位學習精進方案 put tablets into many Changhua classrooms.

questions.q: In a digital-learning plan, 載具 refers to the —
questions.why: 載具 (zàijù) literally 'carrying tool' = device — tablets and laptops. Also the word for a digital receipt carrier in shops.

questions.q: 線上教學 means teaching —
questions.why: 線上 (xiànshàng) = online. 實體 (shítǐ) is the counterpart — in person, physical.

questions.q: 實體課程 means a course held —
questions.why: 實體 (shítǐ) = physical, in the flesh. 實體研習 is an in-person workshop, as opposed to 線上研習.

questions.zh: 這次研習改成線上進行
questions.py: zhè cì yánxí gǎi chéng xiànshàng jìnxíng
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. This workshop has been —
questions.why: 改成 (gǎi chéng) = changed into; 進行 (jìnxíng) = to be conducted or carried out.

questions.q: 進行 means to —
questions.why: 進行 (jìnxíng) = to proceed with. 進行中 (jìnxíng zhōng) = in progress.

questions.q: A 檢核表 is a —
questions.why: 檢核 (jiǎnhé) = to check against criteria. 檢核表 (jiǎnhébiǎo) is the checklist used before an inspection.

questions.q: 指標 in an evaluation framework means —
questions.why: 指標 (zhǐbiāo) = indicator. Evaluation documents list 向度 (dimensions) each broken into 指標.

questions.q: 向度 refers to a —
questions.why: 向度 (xiàngdù) = dimension. 評鑑向度 groups the 指標 into broad areas such as leadership, curriculum, and resources.

questions.q: 分工 refers to the —
questions.why: 分工 (fēngōng) = division of work. 分工合作 (divide the work, work together) is the phrase used when planning an event.

questions.q: 合作 means to —
questions.why: 合作 (hézuò) = to work together. 合作學習 (hézuò xuéxí) is cooperative learning as a teaching method.

questions.q: 達成共識 means the group has —
questions.why: 共識 (gòngshì) = shared understanding. 達成共識 (dáchéng gòngshì) is the aim of most Taiwanese school meetings.

questions.q: 請提出具體建議 asks for suggestions that are —
questions.why: 具體 (jùtǐ) = concrete, specific. Its opposite 抽象 (chōuxiàng) means abstract.

questions.q: 建議 means a —
questions.why: 建議 (jiànyì) = suggestion or recommendation. 我建議… is a safe, collegial way to offer an idea in a meeting.

questions.q: 🔊 Listen. Everyone is being asked to —
questions.why: 提出 (tíchū) = to put forward. 請大家… opens most requests to a room full of colleagues.

questions.q: 落實政策 means to —
opts: put the policy genuinely into practice
questions.why: 落實 (luòshí) = to make something land — implement it for real, not just on paper. Beloved of policy documents.

questions.q: 永續發展 refers to —
questions.why: 永續 (yǒngxù) = sustainable. 永續發展目標 are the UN SDGs, a frequent theme in Taiwanese school projects.

questions.q: 食農教育 teaches students about —
questions.why: 食農教育 (shínóng jiàoyù) = food and agriculture education. Many Changhua schools run rice paddies and vegetable plots.

questions.q: 閱讀推廣 refers to —
questions.why: 閱讀推廣 (yuèdú tuīguǎng) = reading promotion. 晨讀十分鐘 (ten minutes of morning reading) is a common form.

questions.q: 生命教育 addresses —
opts: values, meaning and respect for life
questions.why: 生命教育 (shēngmìng jiàoyù) = life education — ethics, resilience, and the value of life. A named issue in the 課綱.

questions.q: 品德教育 focuses on —
questions.why: 品德教育 (pǐndé jiàoyù) = character education. The 三好校園 (Three Acts of Goodness) scheme sits under it.

questions.q: 三好校園 encourages students to —
opts: do good deeds, speak good words, think good thoughts
questions.why: 三好 = 做好事、說好話、存好心. A Fo Guang Shan-supported scheme that many Changhua schools join.

questions.q: A teacher who leads 以身作則 —
opts: sets the example through their own conduct
questions.why: 以身作則 (yǐ shēn zuò zé) = to make oneself the standard. The core expectation of a Taiwanese teacher, and of 人師.

questions.q: 因勢利導 means to —
opts: guide things along the direction they already tend
questions.why: 因勢利導 (yīn shì lì dǎo) = steer with the current. Good pedagogy: build on what students are already drawn to.

questions.q: 承先啟後 describes a role that —
opts: carries forward what came before and opens the way ahead
questions.why: 承先啟後 (chéng xiān qǐ hòu) = inherit from the past, open the future. Standard at anniversaries and handovers.

questions.q: 任重道遠 says the task is —
questions.why: 任重道遠 (rèn zhòng dào yuǎn) from the 論語 — the burden is heavy and the way far. Said when accepting a serious responsibility.

questions.q: 飲水思源 reminds people to —
opts: find the source of a problem
remember where their good fortune came from
questions.why: 飲水思源 (yǐn shuǐ sī yuán) — drinking water, think of the spring. The phrase for alumni gratitude to a school.

questions.q: Students who are 樂在其中 are —
opts: genuinely enjoying what they are doing
questions.why: 樂在其中 (lè zài qí zhōng) = to find joy within it. The best sentence to have written about your lesson.

questions.q: A 揭牌儀式 marks the —
opts: unveiling of a plaque for a new facility
questions.why: 揭牌 (jiēpái) = to unveil a nameplate. Held when an English Village or new center opens, with 貴賓 and scissors.

questions.q: 締結姊妹校 means to —
questions.why: 締結 (dìjié) = to conclude or establish formally, used for treaties and partnerships. 締結姊妹校 is signed with a ceremony.
